recipes.name: Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Hearty and nutritious lentil soup with vegetables
instructions: Rinse lentils thoroughly
Dice onions, carrots, and celery
Sauté vegetables in olive oil until soft
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
Add lentils, tomatoes, and vegetable broth
Season with cumin, salt, and pepper
Simmer for 30 minutes until lentils are tender
Adjust seasoning and serve with lemon wedges

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Classic comforting soup with tender chicken and vegetables
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces
Sauté onions, carrots, and celery in butter
Add chicken and cook until no longer pink
Pour in chicken broth and bring to boil
Add egg noodles and simmer for 10 minutes
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs
Cook until noodles are tender
Serve hot with fresh parsley

recipes.name: Buckwheat with Chicken
recipes.description: Nutritious buckwheat groats with seasoned chicken
instructions: Season chicken pieces with salt and pepper
Brown chicken in oil until golden
Remove chicken and set aside
Toast buckwheat groats in the same pan
Add water and bring to boil
Place chicken on top of buckwheat
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving

recipes.name: Fish with Vegetables
recipes.description: Light and healthy baked fish with seasonal vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C
Season fish fillets with salt, pepper, and lemon juice
Chop vegetables into even pieces
Toss vegetables with olive oil and herbs
Arrange vegetables in baking dish
Place fish on top of vegetables
Drizzle with olive oil and add lemon slices
Bake for 20-25 minutes until fish flakes easily

recipes.name: Egg Breakfast Plate
recipes.description: Nutritious breakfast with eggs, vegetables, and bread
instructions: Dice tomatoes and cucumbers
Slice bell peppers
Heat butter in pan
Crack eggs and cook to desired doneness
Season eggs with salt and pepper
Arrange vegetables on plate
Add cooked eggs
Serve with bread and cheese

recipes.name: Lagman-style Noodles
recipes.description: Hand-pulled noodles with meat and vegetable sauce
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions
Cut beef into thin strips
Stir-fry beef in hot oil until browned
Add sliced onions, peppers, and tomatoes
Add julienned vegetables and garlic
Season with soy sauce, spices, and herbs
Add broth and simmer for 20 minutes
Serve sauce over cooked noodles

recipes.name: Beshbarmak-style Chicken
recipes.description: Traditional dish with chicken, noodles, and onion sauce
instructions: Boil chicken with onions and bay leaves
Remove chicken and shred meat
Roll out dough and cut into squares
Cook noodle squares in chicken broth
Prepare onion sauce with broth and pepper
Layer noodles on serving plate
Top with chicken pieces
Pour onion sauce over and serve

recipes.name: Vegetable Stew
recipes.description: Hearty vegetable stew with herbs and spices
instructions: Chop all vegetables into similar sizes
Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil
Add carrots and cook for 5 minutes
Add remaining vegetables and tomatoes
Season with herbs and spices
Add vegetable broth and bring to boil
Reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes
Adjust seasoning and serve hot

recipes.name: Chicken Stir Fry
recipes.description: Quick Asian-style stir fry with chicken and vegetables
instructions: Slice chicken into thin strips
Cut vegetables into uniform pieces
Heat oil in wok over high heat
Stir-fry chicken until cooked through
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 3 minutes
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 30 seconds
Pour in sauce mixture and toss
Serve immediately with rice

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Fresh Mediterranean salad with feta and olives
instructions: Chop tomatoes, cucumbers, and bell peppers
Slice red onion thinly
Cube feta cheese
Combine vegetables in large bowl
Add olives and feta
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice
Season with oregano, salt, and pepper
Toss gently and serve immediately

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.description: Classic Italian pasta with rich meat sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef in large pan
Add diced onions, carrots, and celery
Cook vegetables until soft
Add garlic and tomato paste
Pour in crushed tomatoes and beef broth
Season with herbs and simmer for 30 minutes
Cook spaghetti according to package
Serve sauce over spaghetti with parmesan

recipes.name: Vegetable Curry
recipes.description: Aromatic Indian curry with mixed vegetables
instructions: Chop vegetables into bite-sized pieces
Sauté onions in oil until golden
Add ginger, garlic, and curry spices
Add tomatoes and cook until soft
Add vegetables and coconut milk
Simmer until vegetables are tender
Add chickpeas and heat through
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice

recipes.name: Chicken Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican-style soft tacos with seasoned chicken
instructions: Season chicken with taco spices
Cook chicken in pan until done
Shred or dice chicken
Warm tortillas
Dice tomatoes, onions, and lettuce
Assemble tacos with chicken and toppings
Add cheese, salsa, and sour cream
Serve with lime wedges

recipes.name: Salmon Teriyaki
recipes.description: Japanese-style glazed salmon with teriyaki sauce
instructions: Mix soy sauce, mirin, and honey for teriyaki
Marinate salmon for 10 minutes
Heat oil in pan over medium-high
Sear salmon skin-side down for 5 minutes
Flip and cook for 3 minutes
Add teriyaki sauce to pan
Glaze salmon with sauce
Serve with steamed rice and vegetables

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy Italian rice with mushrooms and parmesan
instructions: Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter
Remove mushrooms and set aside
Sauté onions until translucent
Add rice and toast for 2 minutes
Add wine and stir until absorbed
Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring
Continue until rice is creamy and al dente
Stir in mushrooms, butter, and parmesan

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Middle Eastern eggs poached in spicy tomato sauce
instructions: Sauté onions and bell peppers in olive oil
Add garlic and spices
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes
Make wells in the sauce
Crack eggs into wells
Cover and cook until eggs are set
Garnish with feta and parsley
Serve with crusty bread

recipes.name: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: Nutritious bowl with quinoa, roasted vegetables, and tahini
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions
Chop vegetables and toss with olive oil
Roast vegetables at 200°C for 25 minutes
Prepare tahini dressing with lemon and garlic
Massage kale with olive oil
Assemble bowls with quinoa base
Top with roasted vegetables and kale
Drizzle with tahini dressing
